effect_description_eng:
[On Play] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Add 1 card with the [Xros Heart], [Blue Flare] or [Twilight] trait among them to your hand. Return the rest to the bottom of deck. Then, you may play 1 Tamer card with a play cost of 4 or less from your hand without paying the cost.
[On Deletion] ＜Save＞ (You may place this card under one of your Tamers.)
